breed.en: to keep animals to make young ones

cabinet.en: the group of top government ministers

campaigns.en: planned activities to tell people something

noteHi.meaning: दूसरों के साथ मिलकर काम करना; सहयोग।
noteHi.usage: in collaboration with…, collaboration between A and B आम हैं; क्रिया collaborate है।

noteKo.usage: in collaboration with…, collaboration between A and B가 흔하며 동사는 collaborate이다.

commercial.ex: The land is used for commercial farming.

noteHi.meaning: व्यापक; सभी पहलुओं को शामिल करने वाला।
noteHi.usage: विशेषण, प्रायः संज्ञा से पहले (a comprehensive review)। comprehensible (समझने योग्य) से भ्रमित न हों।

noteJa.exampleTr: その報告書は住宅市場について包括的な分析を示している。
noteJa.meaning: 包括的な、総合的な、網羅的な。
noteJa.usage: 形容詞で名詞の前に置くことが多い（a comprehensive review）。comprehensible（理解できる）と混同しないこと。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 보고서는 주택 시장에 대한 포괄적인 분석을 제공한다.
noteKo.usage: 형용사로 주로 명사 앞에 옴(a comprehensive review). comprehensible(이해할 수 있는)과 혼동 주의.

noteHi.exampleTr: धनराशि अच्छे परिणामों पर निर्भर है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 資金は良い結果次第だ。
noteJa.usage: be contingent upon/on ＋名詞 の形。

noteKo.exampleTr: 자금 지원은 좋은 결과에 달려 있다.

department.en: a part of a government or organisation

microchipped.ex: All puppies must be microchipped before sale.
microchipped.ja: マイクロチップを入れた

ministers.ex: The ministers met to discuss the budget.

pay.en: money for work; to give money

preventing.ex: Washing hands helps in preventing disease.

priority.zh: 優先事項（top priority：首要任務）

projects.ex: The city funds many youth projects.

promote.en: to help something become known or used

proposes.ex: The council proposes a new bus lane.

public.ex: Public transport is cheap in the city.

noteJa.usage: 通常は複数形：impose sanctions on…、under sanctions、lift sanctions。

noteKo.usage: 주로 복수형: impose sanctions on…, under sanctions, lift sanctions.

says.ex: My doctor says I need more sleep.

scale.en: how big or serious something is

scrutinise.ex: Voters will scrutinise the new budget.

noteJa.exampleTr: 委員会は新法を精査する。

noteKo.exampleTr: 위원회는 새 법을 면밀히 검토할 것이다.

small.ex: It's a small town in the west.

some.en: a number of people, not all

standards.en: levels of quality that are expected

stiffer.ex: Stiffer penalties may stop dangerous driving.

strategy.en: a plan to reach a goal

stronger.ex: We need stronger laws against pollution.

subjecting.ex: Subjecting animals to cruelty is a crime.

support.ex: The app offers 24-hour support to users.

tag.ex: The price tag on the car was too high.

teach.ex: Grandma will teach me how to bake bread.

there.en: used with "is" to say something exists

tight.ex: Keep a tight rein on your spending.

together.ex: Stir the eggs and milk together.

told.ex: She told me a funny story.

paragraphs: The Government has a new plan to help animals. It will last five years. Martin Heydon, the farm minister, told other ministers about it on Tuesday.
Some people keep too many dogs in bad places to sell the puppies. These are called puppy farms. The plan says these people should pay bigger fines.
Dog wardens may get more power. More dogs should get a microchip. A microchip is a very small tag under the skin. It shows who owns the dog.
The plan also asks owners to keep dogs under control in the countryside. Dogs can attack sheep. There will be more help for horses in cities too.
sentZh: 政府有一個幫助動物的新計畫。
這個計畫為期五年。
農業部長馬丁·海登週二向其他部長說明了這個計畫。
有些人把太多狗養在很差的地方，為了賣小狗。
這些地方被稱為幼犬繁殖場。
計畫說這些人應該付更高的罰款。
犬隻管理員可能會得到更多權力。
應該有更多狗植入晶片。
晶片是放在皮膚下的一個很小的標籤。
它可以顯示狗的主人是誰。
計畫也要求飼主在鄉下要管好自己的狗。
狗可能會攻擊羊。
城市裡的馬也會得到更多幫助。

paragraphs: The Government has a new five-year plan to improve animal welfare. Agriculture Minister Martin Heydon brought the plan to the Cabinet on Tuesday.
A key part of the plan is bigger fines and punishments for puppy farms that treat dogs badly. Puppy farms breed large numbers of dogs to sell, often in poor conditions.
The Government will also think about giving dog wardens more power. It wants more dogs to have a microchip, so owners can be found. Wardens could also give on-the-spot fines.
There will be campaigns to teach people how to be responsible pet owners. Owners will be asked to keep their dogs under control in the countryside, so the dogs do not chase or attack sheep.

The plan also offers more support for horse projects in cities. A new group will look at rules for horse-drawn carts on public roads. The Department of Agriculture and local councils will work more closely together on dogs and horses.
sentZh: 政府有一個改善動物福利的新五年計畫。
農業部長馬丁·海登週二把這個計畫提交給內閣。
計畫的重點之一是對虐待狗的幼犬繁殖場處以更高的罰款和懲罰。
幼犬繁殖場大量繁殖狗來賣，環境通常很差。
政府也會考慮給犬隻管理員更多權力。
政府希望更多狗植入晶片，這樣就能找到飼主。
管理員也可以當場開罰單。
將會有宣導活動，教大家如何當負責任的寵物主人。
飼主會被要求在鄉下管好自己的狗，讓狗不會追逐或攻擊羊。
計畫也為城市裡的馬匹計畫提供更多支持。
一個新小組將研究公共道路上馬車的規定。
農業部和地方議會將在狗和馬的問題上更密切合作。

paragraphs: Tougher fines and sanctions for puppy farms that break welfare rules are a central priority of a new animal welfare strategy brought to Cabinet on Tuesday by Agriculture Minister Martin Heydon.

The five-year plan aims to raise standards of care for animals through a new framework. Puppy farms, which breed dogs in large numbers for sale, have long been criticised for keeping animals in poor conditions.

Under the strategy, the Government will consider giving dog wardens stronger powers, including the use of fixed payment notices, which are on-the-spot fines. It also wants to see more dogs microchipped so that owners can be traced.

Public awareness campaigns on responsible pet ownership will be developed, with a particular focus on preventing sheep worrying, where dogs chase or attack sheep, and on keeping dogs under control in rural areas.

The strategy also promises more support for urban horse projects and a working group to examine how horse-drawn vehicles on public roads should be regulated. Closer cooperation between the Department of Agriculture and local authorities is planned.
sentZh: 對違反福利規定的幼犬繁殖場加重罰款和制裁，是農業部長馬丁·海登週二提交內閣的新動物福利策略的核心重點。
這個五年計畫旨在透過新的框架提高動物照顧的標準。
大量繁殖狗來販賣的幼犬繁殖場，長期因讓動物生活在惡劣環境中而受到批評。
根據這項策略，政府將考慮給犬隻管理員更大的權力，包括使用定額罰款通知，也就是當場罰款。
政府也希望更多狗植入晶片，以便追查飼主。
政府將推出負責任飼養寵物的公眾宣導活動，特別著重於防止狗追逐或攻擊羊的「驚擾羊群」行為，以及在鄉村地區管好狗。
這項策略也承諾為城市馬匹計畫提供更多支持，並成立工作小組研究公共道路上的馬車應如何規範。
農業部和地方政府也計劃加強合作。

paragraphs: Stiffer fines and sanctions for rogue puppy farms are at the heart of a new animal welfare strategy that Agriculture Minister Martin Heydon unveiled to Cabinet on Tuesday.

The five-year blueprint seeks to elevate standards of animal care through an overhauled framework. Puppy farms, which churn out dogs in vast numbers for sale, have long drawn condemnation for subjecting animals to squalid conditions.

Under the strategy, ministers will weigh up beefing up the powers of dog wardens, including the issuing of fixed payment notices, or on-the-spot fines. The plan also champions wider microchipping so that negligent owners can be tracked down.

Awareness campaigns promoting responsible pet ownership will be rolled out, placing particular emphasis on curbing sheep worrying, whereby dogs harass or maul livestock, and on ensuring dogs are kept on a tight rein in the countryside.

The blueprint further pledges bolstered support for urban horse projects and a dedicated working group to scrutinise the regulation of horse-drawn vehicles on public roads. Closer collaboration between the Department of Agriculture and local authorities is also envisaged.
sentZh: 對不肖幼犬繁殖場加重罰款和制裁，是農業部長馬丁·海登週二向內閣公布的新動物福利策略的核心。
這份五年藍圖力求透過全面翻新的框架提升動物照護標準。
大量繁殖狗來販賣的幼犬繁殖場，長期因讓動物處於骯髒惡劣的環境而飽受譴責。
根據這項策略，部長們將權衡是否加強犬隻管理員的權力，包括開立定額罰款通知，也就是當場罰款。
計畫也大力提倡更普及的晶片植入，以便追查失職的飼主。
政府將推出提倡負責任飼養寵物的宣導活動，特別強調遏止狗騷擾或撕咬牲畜的「驚擾羊群」行為，並確保狗在鄉間受到嚴格管束。
這份藍圖還承諾加強對城市馬匹計畫的支持，並成立專責工作小組審視公共道路上馬車的規範。
農業部和地方政府之間也預計將有更密切的合作。

paragraphs: Increased fines and sanctions for puppy farms that breach welfare regulations constitute a central priority of a new animal welfare strategy presented to Cabinet on Tuesday by Agriculture Minister Martin Heydon.

The five-year strategy seeks to promote higher welfare standards by means of a comprehensive new framework. Puppy farms, which breed dogs on a commercial scale, have consistently been criticised for keeping animals in inadequate conditions.

In addition, the Government will consider enhancing the powers of dog wardens, including the authority to issue fixed payment notices. The strategy also advocates an increase in microchipping, thereby facilitating the identification of irresponsible owners.

Furthermore, public awareness campaigns on responsible pet ownership are to be developed, with particular emphasis on preventing sheep worrying and ensuring that dogs remain under control in rural areas.

The strategy also proposes enhanced support for urban horse projects and the establishment of a dedicated working group to examine the regulation of horse-drawn vehicles. Consequently, the effectiveness of these measures will be contingent upon closer collaboration between the Department of Agriculture and local authorities.

這項五年策略力求透過一個全面的新框架推動更高的福利標準。
以商業規模繁殖狗的幼犬繁殖場，一直因讓動物生活在不良環境中而受到批評。
此外，政府將考慮加強犬隻管理員的權力，包括開立定額罰款通知的權限。
這項策略也主張增加晶片植入，從而有助於辨識不負責任的飼主。
此外，政府將推出負責任飼養寵物的公眾宣導活動，特別著重於防止狗驚擾羊群，並確保狗在鄉村地區受到控制。
這項策略也提議加強對城市馬匹計畫的支持，並成立專責工作小組研究馬車的規範。
因此，這些措施的成效將取決於農業部和地方政府之間更密切的合作。
